newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps - Gas oil up on cash support.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps - Gas oil up on cash support.

text.p: Singapore gas oil swaps firmed at midday on Monday as the market came to expect that the recent purchases by local traders would continue for the rest of the month, traders said.
"It doesn't look like the buying will stop soon. They have performed on all their contracts," one trader said.
Brokers said May gas oil swaps were quoted at $25.95/26.10 up from Wednesday's $25.75/25.85. They said May traded earlier in the day at $26.05 and $26.10.
June was quoted at $24.40/$24.60, up a mere 10 cents from last Thursday. It traded earlier in the day at $24.60, brokers said.
As a result, the May/June time spread has widened to value at about $1.50 per barrel, about 30 cents more than Thursday.

Traders said the fact that the local traders have been able to load more than seven million barrels of gas oil and jet fuel purchased showed that the buyers are likely to fulfill their remaining outstanding commitments.
The traders have todate bought about 14 million barrels of gas oil and just under two million barrels of jet fuel since the buying spree started on March 3.
Fuel oil swaps were down slightly on expectations that the recent physical support will not be entended to May.
May was last quoted at $97.50/98.50, down about 50 cents from Thursday.
